note: Alberta Parks recreation area campground on Pinehurst Lake, 48 km southeast of Lac La Biche: two wooded loops of drive-in sites set back from the lake, with a playground between them, a camp store (check-in, groceries, firewood), a beach day-use area joined by trail to the boat launch, and fish-cleaning stations. Hand-pump water is potable, but Alberta Parks recommends bringing drinking water; there is no fill station. A new RV dump station is under construction from Sep 8, 2026 to Apr 30, 2027; until then the nearest dump is at the Rich Lake fire hall. Gravel access road (can rut after heavy rain). Loops A and B close after the September long weekend; the Group Use A area then takes first-come campers (cash or cheque, bring water). --Claude
